debate.title: How much do Fable 5.2's benchmark leaps matter in practice?
debate.consensus: Most builders are impressed by the coding and science gains, especially at the 20% lower price. Skeptics note Fable 5.2 still trails in agentic knowledge work, and the timing right before the IPO roadshow invites scrutiny.

quotes.quote: Clearly their internal benchmarks have become more ambitious!
